_about: Planted-root-cause scenarios for the Investigator agent. Each case mixes reports with ONE hidden cause into same-area noise with other causes. `must_mention` is the scoring rule: the agent's root_cause + affected_segment must contain at least one term from EVERY group (case-insensitive). The scripted baseline uses the same tools in a fixed order.
